note: Contact Formatter provides exactly one field formatter, contact_field_formatter ('Rendered Contact Form'), for entity_reference fields whose target_type is contact_form. It has no configure route (configure=null), no settings, no config schema, no permissions, no services, no Drush and no plugin types. All evals are grounded in that formatter and in entity_view_display config: introspection reads back which field/display uses the formatter; execution switches a field's display component to contact_field_formatter, verified against the live entity_view_display. Fixtures use namespaced field_cfmt_* entity_reference fields targeting contact_form and are deleted on cleanup/reset.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal contrib module contact_formatter, what is the machine id of the field formatter it provides, what human label does it show, and which field type can it be applied to?
evals.expected_output: It provides the formatter contact_field_formatter, labelled 'Rendered Contact Form', for fields of type entity_reference (defined in src/Plugin/Field/FieldFormatter/ContactFieldFormatter.php).

evals.prompt: I want a core contact form to appear inline on my Basic page nodes using the contact_formatter module. What field do I add and how do I display it?
evals.expected_output: Add an entity_reference field whose target type is contact_form to the page bundle, reference the contact form(s) you want, then on Manage display set that field's format to 'Rendered Contact Form' (contact_field_formatter). There are no formatter settings.

evals.prompt: If an entity_reference field displayed with contact_formatter's 'Rendered Contact Form' formatter points at a personal (user) contact form, what does the module render, and how does it decide?
evals.expected_output: It renders nothing for personal contact forms: viewElements() builds a contact_message and checks $message->isPersonal(); only non-personal forms are rendered via the entity form builder.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has one entity-reference field configured to render its referenced contact form inline (using contact_formatter). Inspect the live default view display for Article and give the machine name of that field.
evals.expected_output: The field is field_cfmt_known: in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default its component has type contact_field_formatter.

evals.prompt: The Article content type on this site has two entity-reference fields pointing at contact forms, field_cfmt_on and field_cfmt_off. Exactly one of them renders the contact form inline; the other just shows a label. Inspect the live view-display configuration and state which field renders the form.
evals.expected_output: field_cfmt_on renders the form: in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default its component type is contact_field_formatter, whereas field_cfmt_off uses entity_reference_label.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has an entity-reference field field_cfmt_task that points at a contact form but currently displays only the form's label. Using the contact_formatter module, configure the default view display so that this field renders the referenced contact form inline instead. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_cfmt_task component type is set to contact_field_formatter (e.g. $vd->setComponent('field_cfmt_task', ['type' => 'contact_field_formatter', 'region' => 'content'])->save()), or via Manage display -> Format = 'Rendered Contact Form'.

evals.prompt: On my site the Basic page content type already has a field where I can pick a contact form (field_cfmt_page), but on the page it only shows the form's name as a link. Make it so the contact form itself shows up on the page as a working form that visitors can fill in.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.page.default the field_cfmt_page component is switched to the contact_field_formatter formatter ('Rendered Contact Form'), so the referenced contact form is rendered inline.
